description: Check live advisory activation evidence for one exact variant and an explicit country. An incompatible variant remains purchasable under the storefront policy; unknown is never compatible.

countryCode.description: Explicit ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 activation country; do not infer it from language.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR, BRL or AUD. Prices come back in it, converted from the stored USD price at the verified storefront display rate (usdAmountMinor keeps the USD base); if no rate exists the price stays in USD and moneyCurrency says so. An unsupported code is refused with the list of supported codes.

language.description: Language for product names and links (default en).

productSlug.description: Product or variant slug from a catalogue result.

variantId.description: Exact variant UUID; platform, edition and region are never silently substituted.

name: check_activation_country
title: Check activation country
